scope: Static correctness, security, availability-time and spending-boundary review; offline reconciliation of the existing observation capture.

reviewed_files.limit: Reviewed source-review claims and scope; did not independently reread the cited academic papers in this code review.

resolved_findings.description: Root validation ran only for empty documents; an html root containing a valid-looking item normalized into an eligible observation.
resolved_findings.fix: Require an RSS, Atom or RDF root before extracting items.

resolved_findings.description: UTC conversion of 0001-01-01T00:00:00+01:00 raised uncaught OverflowError, potentially terminating collection before its receipt was written.
resolved_findings.fix: Treat UTC conversion overflow as an unknown publication timestamp; retain an ineligible observation.
regressions: test_no_invented_publication_time: minimum and maximum datetime boundaries

test_count_interpretation: The current suite contains 26 artificial fixture and mocked-HTTP cases. The two runs are not 48 distinct tests or trading backtests.

offline_capture_checks.ineligible_reason: All 13 links use blogs.nvidia.com, outside the deliberately narrow newsroom-host allowlist.

patched_parser_offline_replay.scope: Compatibility replay of saved feeds through patched normalization, separate from the independent standard-library row and aggregate checks.

boundaries_confirmed: CLI uses exactly three fixed HTTPS feed endpoints; no item-link fetching, redirect following or application retry loop.
Decoded feed payloads above 2 MiB and feeds above 500 items are rejected.
DOCTYPE and ENTITY declarations are rejected before XML parsing.
First-seen, retrieval and asserted publication timestamps remain separate; future or unknown times are ineligible.
Changed normalized content receives a new version hash; the current row cannot be used before its own retrieval timestamp.
Existing output directories are refused before HTTP requests, preserving captured evidence.
No model, paid-data or order-execution path exists in the reviewed script.
Public evidence contains aggregates and hashes rather than full captured article text.

price_dossier_check.caveat_already_present: Prices are listed subscription amounts; no checkout/tax quote obtained.

limitations: This is a current feed-observation pilot, not historical availability reconstruction, financial sentiment validation or a stock-selection model.
Eligible means timestamp and URL hygiene only; duplicate eligible rows are not independent events or trading opportunities.
Content versions identify normalized URL/title/summary/publication-string tuples, not every byte or linked article body.
Publication timestamps remain publisher assertions; local clock and trusted local capture provenance are assumptions.
Hashes detect content mismatch but are not cryptographic attestations of historical publication or protection against rewriting every local receipt.
HTTP timeouts are per-operation, not an independently enforced total wall-clock deadline.
The reviewer did not rerun the live collection, independently audit provider access logs, or repeat the separate author's lint/type checks.
No causal price impact, profitable trade, annual-return floor or broker readiness follows from this review.
